ctx.x: He was the lead alto player with Earl Walton's band at the Palais, one of the leading dance halls -- because the dance hall was a big outlet for musicians in those days, because everybody was dancing to our kind of music -- either jazz or some form of music, we called the sweet bands or the hot bands -- the jazz bands were the hot bands, so Billy Minor's band was flourishing, and as I said, McKinney's Cotton Pickers were going strong in Detroit.
